title: 'OH.' // SPF 5000 DORNISH DRAGON OINTMENT
narrative: In the dragon pit beneath Meereen, Rhaegal exhales a column of thermonuclear hellfire directly onto Prince Quentyn. Quentyn looks down at his smoking clothes. His skin is moisturized and pleasantly tan. 'Oh,' he says again, this time in delight. 'Archmaester Marwyn's SPF 5000 Dornish dragon-ointment worked! The burnt corpse in Barristan's hospital was just a roasted tavern ham dressed in Martell armor!' Quentyn high-fives Viserion and takes an Uber dragon home.
